name: @w6w-apps/bloomerang
description: Manage Bloomerang nonprofit CRM constituents, donations, funds, notes and tasks via the Bloomerang REST API v2.

w6w.longDescription:
Bloomerang is a donor management / fundraising CRM built for small and mid-sized nonprofits, and this app covers its core objects through the Bloomerang REST API v2 — constituents (donors, households and organizations), donations and other transactions, funds, notes and tasks.

It searches and manages constituent records, records donations against a fund with the same Designation model the Bloomerang UI itself uses, looks up funds to resolve the ids a donation needs, and logs notes and tasks against a constituent's timeline.

Good for teams that want to create or update donor records from an external signup form or event platform, log a donation processed elsewhere (this app never touches payment data — Bloomerang's private-key API is for server-to-server data sync, not for taking payment), or keep follow-up tasks and notes in sync with an outside tool.
